_doc: GROWTH-2: the knobs the product manager loop may turn (foundation/pm.py). Each is bounded, changed at most once a week, logged with its prediction in ops/growth/knob-log.jsonl, and reverted by the next review when the metric it was meant to move is no better. Anything not listed here is not a knob.

knobs.what: the share of shipped work that must be growth; the executor takes a growth item first below it
how many times a day the executor may wake itself; raised when work waits and nothing merges unattended
how many recent merges the growth share is measured over
